items.problem: `test evidence`. Before this range, and unrelated to it: no test goes through the failure path of `## error` "reward grant failure (failure of `grant_or_mail`)" → `INTERNAL`. Every `CORE_ERROR_INTERNAL` assert in `server/core/attendance/tests/` is a hook case (hooks.test.ts:114, 140, 205, 232). Run path: in a temporary copy, `default: return CoreError.CORE_ERROR_INTERNAL` was changed to `return 'pass'`, and `server/core/attendance/tests` still passed 32 of 32 on SQLite, so a failed grant answering success with progress saved would not be caught. The data checks block a group item and a bad amount in the reward (tools/data-tool/src/checks/item-ledger.ts), so `test-data` rows are unlikely to reach this path; a test probably needs a `mailbox` that returns a failure value, or the `INVALID_INPUT` of `send_mail` or of the `<once_key>:<k>` collision.
